newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to head lower if 109-16 gives way.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to head lower if 109-16 gives way.

text.p: British gilts will suffer on Monday as long as they fail to convincingly pierce key resistance around 109-16,18, technical analysts said.
"We broke down through five-day trendline support late on Friday so I'm looking for continued weakness in gilts for now," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch here.
By 0711 GMT the June gilt was hovering around the critical band of resistance, down 8/32 at 109-16. It hit an early high of 109-19 but failed to make any headway from there.
Branigan said 109-16 was the low from April 16 and 109-18 was a potential head and shoulders neckline.

Branigan said a sustained break below 109-16 would open up a move down towards 108-22, the head and shoulders top objective on hourly charts. "But I wouldn't have thought that will happen today," he said.
If the market can hold above the potential neckline of 109-18, the June contract should be able to retest recent highs around 110-10, said Branigan.

Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell here agreed 109-16 was the crucial level to watch. "A break of this would signal that the upside retracement is complete, triggering a resumption of the overall bear move," they said in a morning note.
They said a retreat through there would put the 108-21 trendline support to the test.
"The latter marks the trigger for 108-05 initially, ahead of more medium term declines to the 107-24 area," said DMG.
That is the 61.8 percent retracement of the March 1996 to February 1997 rally and trendline support from September 1996.

To the upside, a rally through the 110-10,14 area would be needed over the next few days to confirm potential to the 110-28, 111-00 region, they said. "Upticks to this area, if achieved, would offer selling opportunities."
By 0731 GMT, June short sterling was down 0.02 at 93.40.
